text: 1次元箱型井戸・量子調和振動子 Small 1D box and quantum harmonic-oscillator eigenpairs 1次元箱型井戸・量子調和振動子 H_h=-\frac12D_{xx}+V,\quad V_{\rm box}=0,\quad V_{\rm HO}=x^2/2;\quad E_j^{\rm box}=\frac{(j\pi)^2}{2},\quad u_j=\sqrt2\sin(j\pi x),\quad\lambda_{h,j}=2h^{-2}\sin^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{2M}\right),\ h=1/M;\quad E_n^{\rm HO}=n+\frac12,\quad u_n(x)=\frac{H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}}{\pi^{1/4}\sqrt{2^nn!}},\quad u_h=v_h/\sqrt h 原子単位、ゼロDirichlet端点、一様内点格子。箱[0,1]とHO[-L,L]です。 1次元模型の原子単位でℏ=m=1、HOはω=1。箱[0,1]とHOの有限区間[-L,L]はいずれも同次Dirichlet。 Small 1D box and quantum harmonic-oscillator eigenpairs H_h=-\frac12D_{xx}+V,\quad V_{\rm box}=0,\quad V_{\rm HO}=x^2/2;\quad E_j^{\rm box}=\frac{(j\pi)^2}{2},\quad u_j=\sqrt2\sin(j\pi x),\quad\lambda_{h,j}=2h^{-2}\sin^2\left(\frac{j\pi}{2M}\right),\ h=1/M;\quad E_n^{\rm HO}=n+\frac12,\quad u_n(x)=\frac{H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}}{\pi^{1/4}\sqrt{2^nn!}},\quad u_h=v_h/\sqrt h Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1.
